jake-wade: Jake brings energy and adventure to everything he does. He loves being involved at his church, spending weekends on the softball field, and making memories with his nieces and nephew.

His outgoing personality and natural enthusiasm make him someone clients instantly feel comfortable with. Jake enjoys tackling challenges head-on and finding creative solutions that make life easier for the people he serves.
jonathan-arosemena: Jonathan is deeply committed to his faith, his family, and the community around him. As a husband and father of three young kids, he understands the importance of reliability, trust, and follow-through.

When he is not working, you will likely find him taking walks at the park with his family or serving at church. Jonathan brings steady leadership, thoughtful communication, and a genuine desire to help clients solve problems with clarity and confidence.
danny: Danny came to window treatments from custom decks, patios and fences, and from firefighting. Love Is Blinds has let him build a customer-focused business while still working with his hands.
dustin: Dustin is the owner and president of Love Is Blinds and the company's lead design tech. He is unapologetically a family man as well as a Christian. Dustin has been in the world of window treatments for almost a decade. Whether selling, measuring or installing, there is a holistic pride and joy that Dustin takes in his company.
durrell: Durrell grew up in a Mennonite family in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, where he was instilled with strong values of faith, family, and hard work. Working alongside his father in the family business from a young age, he developed a deep appreciation for craftsmanship, quality, and taking pride in a job well done.

Today, Durrell brings those same values to his own business, where he is committed to quality workmanship, honest service, and building lasting relationships with his customers. Above all, he is a devoted husband and father who values family and strives to lead his business and his home with the same integrity, faith, and strong work ethic that shaped him from an early age.
